metadata.description: Stroq — find known secrets in AI coding agent sessions, then guard the next one

plugins.name: stroq
plugins.description: Guards Claude Code's tool calls: scans what the agent reads, names the file or result that dictated a command, and blocks secret egress and risky follow-ups. Local, no telemetry. Pair with `npx @stroq/cli sent --last` to find known secrets in past sessions.
